Offline saving is deliberately locked down because it adds copyright and platform-terms risk. Official Plyvanta allows authorized personal offline entertainment only and provides no app-provided playable-file access, export, or share path to discourage redistribution.
Play a supported video before saving it offline.
Technically eligible for device-locked offline playback. Save only if permitted.
Live, HLS, and DASH streams cannot be saved securely yet.
Confirm you may save this video

Downloading media can conflict with platform terms and may implicate copyright. Personal offline entertainment is this feature’s intended use, but personal use or ownership alone does not grant platform permission. Continue only if the platform’s terms and applicable law permit you to download this content. Plyvanta cannot verify that permission.

The device lock is deliberate: official Plyvanta is not intended to become a convenient way to redistribute free copies of media that may be protected by copyright. There is no app-provided playable-file access, export, share, cast, backup, or migration path.

Plyvanta’s code is open source, so forks can remove these safeguards. The code license grants no rights to media, and a fork’s choices are not official upstream policy. Official builds keep a meaningful practical barrier against redistribution. Keep Plyvanta open until encryption finishes.

Official Plyvanta offers device-locked downloads only for authorized personal, on-device entertainment—not redistribution. Copyright law and applicable third-party service terms still apply; Plyvanta cannot verify or grant media rights. Its open-source code license grants no rights to media. Forks can alter the safeguards, but those choices are not official upstream policy.
Route playback, video lookups, SponsorBlock, downloads, and update checks through Orbot. No direct fallback.
Start Orbot and wait until it connects to Tor. Its SOCKS proxy must be enabled. For proxy-only use, enable Power User Mode in Orbot’s General settings.
Install Orbot from its official download page, then start it and enable its SOCKS proxy. This opens your browser, which uses its own network settings.
Checking the Tor Project through Orbot…
Tor routing enabled. Connection has not been checked.
Tor is off. Plyvanta uses your normal connection.
The Tor Project verified a Tor exit for this check.
This proxy did not use a Tor exit. Check Orbot before playing.
Could not verify Tor. Start Orbot, wait for it to connect, and check the SOCKS port. Plyvanta will not fall back to a direct connection.
Match Orbot’s SOCKS proxy port (normally 9050). Plyvanta connects only to the proxy on this phone.

Tor hides your network IP from services contacted by Plyvanta. It can be slower, and YouTube may block Tor exits. Accounts and information you share can still identify you. Other apps and browser links use their own network settings.
Network route changed. Tap Play to start with the new connection.
Network route changed. Offline media stays on this device.
Could not save the network setting. Check the current setting before continuing.
Plyvanta’s Tor setting covers its own requests. The browser or app you open uses its own connection. Configure that app to use Tor if you want this link or report to go through Tor.
Playback through Tor failed. Confirm Orbot is connected and use Check Tor connection in Settings. YouTube may block this Tor exit. Plyvanta will not retry on your direct connection.
